approaches.name: Displacement tracking data and spatial IDP database for targeting
approaches.description: Uses IOM displacement tracking data and a national spatial IDP registration database to select target areas and beneficiaries. Practices: IOM-DTM displacement data for targeting IDP beneficiaries; National spatial IDP database from registration and displacement surveys.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: displacement data-driven beneficiary targeting - cue: 'pilot' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: The International Organization for Migration (IOM)-Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) data will be considered to select the target communities at the LGA and ward levels.22 IOM-DTM data will be the basis for the identification of project beneficiaries.

extra_evidence.text: (ii) financial and technical support to address the data gaps concerning IDPs, including women, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups; and (iii) financial and technical support to carry out a registration and profiling process of IDPs, including conducting the displacement surveys elaborated in the PIM and building a spatial database for IDPs in participating states that identify IDPs as one of their key development challenges.45 States will finance the state-level work while the project will finance the coordination of the states’ efforts and the development of a national database.

evidence.text: The state PCUs will be responsible for operationalizing the state-level Results Framework and results monitoring system and leveraging GEMS for activity mapping and data collection.

extra_evidence.text: Data collection through geotagging will be supported by regular beneficiary phone surveys to track social cohesion, levels of participation in project activities, satisfaction, and so on.
